import os,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile,hashlib,json
root=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='opencut-ff-preservation-',dir='/tmp'))
env={**os.environ,'GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS':'0'}
def git(*args,check=True):
 p=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(root),*args],env=env,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
 if check and p.returncode:raise RuntimeError((args,p.stdout,p.stderr))
 return p
def put(path,text):
 p=root/path;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_text(text)
def relevant(path):return path.startswith(('.activity/','docs/')) or path in ['rules.md','collision.txt']
def state():
 status=[x for x in git('status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all').stdout.splitlines() if relevant(x[3:])]
 index=[x for x in git('ls-files','--stage').stdout.splitlines() if relevant(x.split('\t',1)[1])]
 hashes={str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '.git' not in p.relative_to(root).parts and relevant(str(p.relative_to(root)))}
 return status,index,hashes
